name: Path of the Berserker
description: A path of untrammeled fury, channeling rage into a violent frenzy.

name: College of Lore
tagline: Plumb the Depths of Magical Knowledge
description: Bards of the College of Lore collect spells and secrets from diverse sources, such as scholarly tomes, mystical rites, and peasant tales. The college's members gather in libraries and universities to share their lore with one another. They also meet at festivals or affairs of state, where they can expose corruption, unravel lies, and poke fun at self-important figures of authority.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: You gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: You learn to use your wit to supernaturally distract, confuse, and otherwise sap the confidence and competence of others. When a creature that you can see within 60 feet of yourself makes a damage roll or succeeds on an ability check or attack roll, you can take a Reaction to expend one use of your Bardic Inspiration; roll your Bardic Inspiration die, and subtract the number rolled from the creature's roll, reducing the damage or potentially turning the success into a failure.

features.name: Magical Discoveries
features.description:
You learn two spells of your choice. These spells can come from the Cleric, Druid, or Wizard spell list or any combination thereof (see a class's section for its spell list). A spell you choose must be a cantrip or a spell for which you have spell slots, as shown in the Bard Features table.

You always have the chosen spells prepared, and whenever you gain a Bard level, you can replace one of the spells with another spell that meets these requirements.

features.name: Peerless Skill
features.description: When you make an ability check or attack roll and fail, you can expend one use of Bardic Inspiration; roll the Bardic Inspiration die, and add the number rolled to the d20, potentially turning a failure into a success. On a failure, the Bardic Inspiration isn't expended.

name: Life Domain
tagline: Preserve and Heal Those in Need
description: Clerics devoted to the life force that sustains all things; potent healers.

name: Circle of the Land
tagline: Draw on the Magic of the Natural World
description: Druids who draw magic from a particular landscape, mystical lore, and folk ritual.

name: Champion
description: Fighters who pursue physical excellence and devastating critical strikes.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
description: Monks who master unarmed combat, manipulating an enemy's ki and body.

name: Oath of Devotion
tagline: Uphold Lofty Ideals of Justice and Order
description: Paladins bound to the ideals of justice, virtue, and order.

name: Hunter
tagline: Hunt the Monsters That Threaten Civilization
description: Rangers who specialize in hunting the monsters that threaten the world.

name: Thief
description: Rogues who hone the skills of stealth, agility, and quick reflexes.

name: Draconic Sorcery
description: Sorcerers whose innate magic springs from a draconic bloodline.

name: Fiend Patron
tagline: Bargain with the Lower Planes for Fell Powers
description: Warlocks who bargain with a powerful fiend of the Lower Planes.

name: School of Evocation
description: Wizards who focus on the energetic magic of evocation spells.
